title: Development of a competitive ELISA based on estrogen receptor and weak competitive molecule for the screening of potential estrogens in foods.
authors: Wang, Ying; Wang, Minglu; Zhou, Li; Geng, Xiangye; Xu, Zhixiang; Zhang, Hongyan
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于雌激素受体的竞争性ELISA用于食品中雌激素筛查，属纯实验检测方法，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Enzyme labeled competitive molecules are generally homologous with competitors in competitive broad-spectrum enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA). It is speculated that the detectability will be improved when the competitiveness of competitive molecule is weak. Herein, common small molecule food hazard-estrogen disrupting chemicals (EDCs) were used as target model for verification. The dual-estrogen receptor (ER) and three estrogen-enzyme conjugates with various responses were used as recognizers and competitive molecules in ELISA. ELISA based on bisphenol (BPA)-horseradish peroxidase (HRP) has the highest detectability and can screen all six EDCs, in which BPA-HRP showed the weakest ER excitatory activity (Ka = 1.39 x 10(-2) nmol.L(-1)) among three conjugates. The proposal showed good practicability with spiked recovery of 80.0-110 % for estrogens (17beta-estradiol, 17alpha-estradiol, BPA) in foodstuffs, and revealed biomarkers with weak competitiveness may be applied to other competitive procedures to improve detectability, and it provides sensitive pre-screening strategy for follow-up screening tool.
abstract_zh: 酶标竞争分子通常与竞争性广谱酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）中的竞争者同源。推测当竞争分子的竞争性较弱时，可检测性将得到提高。本文以常见的小分子食品危害物——雌激素干扰化学物（EDCs）作为目标模型进行验证。采用双雌激素受体（ER）和三种响应各异的雌激素-酶结合物分别作为ELISA中的识别分子和竞争分子。基于双酚（BPA）-辣根过氧化物酶（HRP）的ELISA具有最高的可检测性，并能筛查全部六种EDCs，其中BPA-HRP在三种结合物中表现出最弱的ER激动活性（Ka = 1.39 x 10(-2) nmol.L(-1)）。该方案在实际应用中表现出良好的实用性，对食品中的雌激素（17β-雌二醇、17α-雌二醇、BPA）加标回收率为80.0-110%，并揭示弱竞争性的生物标志物可能适用于其他竞争性程序以提高可检测性，为后续筛查工具提供了灵敏的预筛查策略。
